scope: Seven exact homogeneous-polynomial/coordinate identities only. No finite sample is used for the all-prime Picard or all-dimension theorem.

checks.name: odd_transverse_section
checks.explanation: Three distinct lines over every field of characteristic different from two.

checks.name: char2_transverse_section
checks.explanation: Three distinct lines in characteristic two.

checks.name: odd_x_zero_hyperplane
checks.explanation: The hyperplane x=0 cuts 2P+O; subtracting z=0 gives div(x/z)=2P-2O.

checks.name: char2_infinity_hyperplane
checks.explanation: Subtracting the infinity hyperplane gives div(y/z)=3P-3O.

checks.name: distinct_named_points
checks.explanation: The Abel isomorphism in the written proof makes P-O nonzero.
